statement: For positive n let e(n)=n+(n mod 2) and w(n)=log((e(n)+1)/(e(n)-1)). Lean proves w(n)>0 and sum_{n in E(m)}w(n)=w(m) for every positive m and the actual even Juggler fibre E(m), including exact conservation through every complete even inverse generation. It proves finite weighted reindexing with arbitrary real target amplitudes. For either actual signed 2-adic code H, any code predicate B, integer X>=1 and M=floor(sqrt X), codedMass_H(2B,X)=codedMass_H(B,M-1)+1_{B(H(M))}*partialMass(X,M), with 0<=partialMass(X,M)<=w(M). The infinite nonnegative coded mass is defined as the supremum of its source cutoffs; nu_H(2B)=nu_H(B), allowing infinity, follows from the cutoff bounds. A separate finite even-source identity retains any full fate predicate A(n) iff A(J(n)). Finally H_minus(16)=H_minus(18), no odd integer maps to 16, and J(7)=18. For the unconditional minus 2-adic Juggler code H and the weight w of J-even-fibre-exact-log-weight, define nu_X(B)=sum_{1<=n<=X,H(n) in B} w(n) and nu(B) with all positive starts, allowing infinity. For every set B, nu(2B)=nu(B). For integer X>=1 and M=floor(sqrt X), nu_X(2B)=nu_{M-1}(B)+1_{H(M) in B}*sum_{n in E(M),n<=X}w(n), where E(M) is the even Juggler fibre; the boundary term lies between zero and w(M). The d-th complete even inverse generation of 2 has total weight log 3 and common code 2^(d+1) for every d>=0, so nu({2^(d+1)})>=log 3. Consequently no finite K gives nu({q})<=K/q for all positive integer codes q. For every positive integer n set e(n)=n+(n mod 2) and w(n)=log((e(n)+1)/(e(n)-1)). For every positive target m, the sum of w(n) over all even Juggler predecessors of m equals w(m) exactly. Also 1/n<=w(n)<=4/n and |w(n)-2/n|<=2/n^2; hence any source subset and cutoff have weighted mass differing from twice reciprocal mass by at most 4. For each real c this conservation law has a unique real-valued solution v with n*v(n)->c, namely v=(c/2)*w.
